payload.credit_html: "﻿Fossil assemblage from the Khok Pha Suam locality of northeastern, Thailand: an overview of vertebrate diversity from the Early Cretaceous Khok Kruat Formation (Aptian-Albian)"
payload.description_html: Locality map of the Khok Kruat Formation in Thailand. a. Map of Thailand, showing the location of the Khorat Plateau; b. Distribution of the Khok Kruat Formation in northeastern Thailand (green color; modified from DMR, 2004), indicating the locations of Ban Pha Nang Sua locality (orange star, left) and Khok Pha Suam locality (red star, right)
